feature: MIN and MAX aggregates with implicit GROUP BY over a vulnerability-finding-alert traversal

scenarios.name: earliest alert time, highest score and alert count per vulnerability over a finding-to-alert traversal
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (min and max over grouped values, null-skipping, all-null group)
scenarios.query: MATCH (v:grid_fixtures__hub)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(f:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN v.name AS vulnerability, MIN(a.data.observed_at) AS first_seen, MAX(a.data.severity_score) AS highest, COUNT(a) AS alerts ORDER BY vulnerability

scenarios.name: latest report time per scanner (MAX of a date-time, nulls ignored)
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (min and max over grouped values, null-skipping, all-null group)
scenarios.query: MATCH (f:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN a.data.kind AS scanner, MAX(a.data.observed_at) AS last_report ORDER BY scanner

scenarios.name: MIN and MAX per finding: a date-time is compared as an instant, nulls are ignored, an all-null group is null
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (min and max over grouped values, null-skipping, all-null group)
scenarios.query: MATCH (f:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN f.name AS finding, MIN(a.data.observed_at) AS first_seen, MAX(a.data.observed_at) AS last_seen, MIN(a.data.severity_score) AS lowest, MAX(a.data.severity_score) AS highest ORDER BY finding

scenarios.name: an all-aggregate RETURN is one group and yields one row
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (min and max over grouped values, null-skipping, all-null group)
scenarios.query: MATCH (f:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN MIN(a.data.severity_score) AS lowest, MAX(a.data.severity_score) AS highest, MIN(a.data.observed_at) AS first_seen, MAX(a.data.observed_at) AS last_seen, COUNT(a) AS alerts

scenarios.name: COUNT alone with no group key is one row, not one row per match
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (min and max over grouped values, null-skipping, all-null group)
scenarios.query: MATCH (f:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN COUNT(a) AS alerts

scenarios.name: COUNT alone over an OPTIONAL MATCH is one total row, not one row per anchor
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (an aggregate with no grouping key over an optional match)
scenarios.query: MATCH (f:grid_fixtures__leaf) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN COUNT(a) AS alerts

scenarios.name: an all-aggregate RETURN over no matches is one row: COUNT 0, MAX null
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (aggregation over an empty match set)
scenarios.query: MATCH (f:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) WHERE a.data.severity_score > 100 RETURN MAX(a.data.severity_score) AS highest, COUNT(a) AS alerts

scenarios.name: WHERE filters the rows before MAX sees them
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (min and max over grouped values, null-skipping, all-null group)
scenarios.query: MATCH (f:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) WHERE a.data.kind = "scanner-x" RETURN f.name AS finding, MAX(a.data.severity_score) AS highest ORDER BY finding

scenarios.name: ORDER BY an aggregate column with LIMIT
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (min and max over grouped values, null-skipping, all-null group)
scenarios.query: MATCH (v:grid_fixtures__hub)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(f:grid_fixtures__leaf)-[:PG_LINKS__grid_fixtures]->(a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN v.name AS vulnerability, MAX(a.data.severity_score) AS highest ORDER BY highest DESC LIMIT 2
